signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a two-story gray colonial with attached two-car garage, front porch, and lawn. A large tree in the foreground partially obscures the left side of the facade.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Mulched beds and a trimmed shrub are visible, but there is no crew, equipment, or other clear sign of professional service.

signals.notes: Well-kept home with fresh-looking asphalt driveway, basketball hoop at the curb side of the driveway, and green utility boxes at the right edge of the lawn.
